objectives: “The course aims to impart moderate to advanced knowledge regarding probability and statistics, and the application to reliability and risk assessment, especially in geotechnical engineering.  After the course, the students are able to evaluate the reliability of geotechnical facilities, and make proper decisions during reliability-based designs.“
content:
“Review of probability and statistics
Bayesian approach
Function of random variable
Monte Carlo Simulation
Point estimate method
First-order second-moment approach
Advanced first-order second-moment approach
Markov chain
Load and resistance factor design“
books:
“Probability concept in engineering: emphasis on applications to civil and environmental engineering, 2nd ed., by A. Ang abd W. Tang
Risk assessment in geotechnical engineering, by G. Fenton and D.V. Griffiths“
grading_policy:
考試 90%
作業5%
課堂表現5%
